description:
Uchie Relax is a sparkling kava seltzer crafted with magnesium and L-theanine. Zero alcohol, 12 oz cans, built for the part of the day when you want to downshift.

Uchie is stocked in thousands of retail doors across Southern California, on Amazon and Walmart, and at uchie.com. We're now opening our affiliate program to a founding group of partners.

What you earn
13% of the product subtotal on every order you refer. 30-day cookie, last click. PayPal payouts monthly.

What you get
One free cases when you're approved, restocked while you're active. Approved hooks, captions, and product photography, so you're never starting from a blank page. No contract and no minimum posting requirement.

Who does well here
Creators working in wellness routines, mindful living, mocktails and home bartending, and anyone whose audience actually reads the ingredient panel. Evening-ritual and wind-down content performs best for us.

One thing to know upfront
Uchie Relax is a dietary supplement, which means there are real rules about how it can be described. We'll send you a short approved-language guide when you're accepted. It keeps both of us clear of FDA and FTC trouble, and it makes writing easier, not harder. If you're comfortable working inside those lines, you'll do well with us.

Applications are reviewed manually — we'll get back to you within 3 business days.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Uchie Relax! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may promote through their own organic social content, email lists, websites, and paid social advertising to their own audiences. Affiliates may not: bid on "Uchie," "Uchie Relax," or any variation or misspelling in paid search; use display URLs containing our domain; post coupon codes to coupon aggregation, deal, or cashback sites including but not limited to RetailMeNot, Honey, Slickdeals, or browser extensions; use incentivized traffic, pop-unders, or adware; purchase our products for resale on Amazon, Walmart, eBay, or any marketplace; or use our trademarks in domain names, social handles, or app names.

2. Prohibited claims

Uchie Relax is a dietary supplement. Affiliate may not state or imply that the product diagnoses, treats, cures, mitigates, or prevents any disease or health condition, including but not limited to anxiety, depression, insomnia, sleep disorders, stress disorders, or pain. Affiliate may not position the product as a substitute for, alternative to, or replacement for alcohol, or use language including "buzz," "hangover-free," "instead of a drink," or comparable framing. Affiliate may not make claims regarding kava, magnesium, or L-theanine beyond the approved language guide provided by Merchant. Affiliate may not market to persons under 21, or to persons who are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication affecting liver function. Merchant may require removal of any content within 24 hours of written notice.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: hello@uchie.com.

8. FTC Disclosure

Every post carries a clear and conspicuous #ad or #sponsored disclosure, visible without expanding text, per 16 CFR Part 255. Non-compliant content is grounds for immediate termination.

9. Termination and clawback

Either party may terminate at any time for any reason. Merchant may terminate immediately and void all unpaid commissions for violation of the claims, disclosure, or channel provisions. Commissions on fraudulent or self-referred orders are forfeit.

10. Indemnification

Affiliate indemnifies Marina Technology LLC against claims arising from affiliate's content, representations, or violation of law. This is what stands between you and an FTC action triggered by someone else's caption.

11. Content license, both directions

Affiliate gets a limited, revocable, non-transferable license to your marks and approved assets, terminating on program exit. Affiliate grants you a perpetual license to repurpose their Uchie content in your own paid and organic marketing — you're running Meta and AppLovin, and creator UGC is the highest-performing asset class there. Getting those rights in the terms is free.

12. Eligibility

21+, US-based, not a competitor or employed by one.

13. Independent contractor

No employment, agency, or partnership relationship. Affiliate responsible for own taxes.

14. Governing law

California, venue in Los Angeles County.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to hello@uchie.com for support.
